import React, { useState } from "react"; export default function HostelComplaintPage() { const [form, setForm] = useState({ name: "", rollNo: "", email: "", phoneNumber: "", hostelName: "", roomNumber: "", complaintType: "", complaint: "", }); function onChange(e) { const { id, value } = e.target; setForm((p) => ({ ...p, [id]: value })); } function onSubmit(event) { event.preventDefault(); const complaintData = { name: form.name, rollNo: form.rollNo, email: form.email, phoneNumber: form.phoneNumber, hostelName: form.hostelName, roomNumber: form.roomNumber, complaintType: form.complaintType, complaint: form.complaint, }; const complaints = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem("complaints")) || []; complaints.push(complaintData); localStorage.setItem("complaints", JSON.stringify(complaints)); alert("Complaint submitted successfully!"); setForm({ name: "", rollNo: "", email: "", phoneNumber: "", hostelName: "", roomNumber: "", complaintType: "", complaint: "", }); } return ( <>
